label: T2.1-zero-work-green
command:
import hashlib,json,sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,"C:/Users/admin/Documents/Projects/ForAgentCode/TDQ-Workflow/docs/tdq/artifacts/2026-11-01-1045-toi-uu-bon-hang-muc")
import safe_run_telemetry as adapter
path=Path(sys.argv[1])
receipt=adapter.validate_receipt(path,Path.cwd())
rows=[json.loads(line[len("TDQ_SCOPE_WORK "):]) for line in (path.parent/"stdout.txt").read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith("TDQ_SCOPE_WORK ")]
targets=[arg for arg in receipt["command"] if arg.startswith(("tests/test_tdq_test.py::So::","tests/test_team_mode.py::CliTest::"))]
assert len(targets)==4
observed=[]
for case in targets:
    selected=[row for row in rows if row["case_id"]==case]
    assert len(selected)==1
    fact=selected[0]
    raw=Path(fact["observation_log"]).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==fact["observation_sha256"]
    events=[json.loads(line) for line in raw.decode().splitlines()]
    assert all(event["case_id"]==case for event in events)
    counts=Counter(event["kind"] for event in events)
    assert fact["subprocess_calls"]==counts["process"]+counts["git"]
    assert fact["calibration_calls"]==counts["calibration"] and fact["git_calls"]==counts["git"]
    assert fact["source_file_sha256"]==receipt["source_before"]["files"][case.split("::")[0]]
    observed.append({key:fact[key] for key in ("case_id","subprocess_calls","calibration_calls","git_calls")})
print("TDQ_ZERO_WORK_CONTRACT "+json.dumps({"receipt_sha256":hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"facts":observed}),flush=True)
assert all(row["subprocess_calls"]==row["calibration_calls"]==row["git_calls"]==0 for row in observed),"Zero-work contract failed on actual guarded baseline observations"

source_before.scope: git inputs; explicit generated exclusions, not hermetic eligibility

source_after.scope: git inputs; explicit generated exclusions, not hermetic eligibility

dependency_before.scope: Archify entrypoint/package, Node and explicit browser binaries; not transitive dependency eligibility

dependency_after.scope: Archify entrypoint/package, Node and explicit browser binaries; not transitive dependency eligibility
